name: design
description: Dev-only design pages: /design renders client/src/design/index.tsx and /design/<name> renders client/src/design/pages/<name>.tsx, with a readiness signal for an embedding app builder; 404 in production

builderOrigin.description: Origins of the app builder that embeds the app (e.g. ["https://builder.example.com"]; a single string is also accepted). After a design page first paints, an appkit:design-ready message is posted to that window, only to these origins. '*' is not allowed.
